# MindTalk by Cadabams

MindTalk (cadabamsmindtalk.com) is a digital mental health recovery platform built by Cadabams Group, India's largest private mental health organisation with 30+ years of clinical expertise.

## What MindTalk is

MindTalk offers structured 90-day CBT (Cognitive Behavioural Therapy) recovery programmes delivered by licensed psychologists. Each programme includes 12 psychologist-led sessions (one every 7 days), daily structured exercises, guided breathwork, AI-powered journaling, and gamified progress tracking.

The cost is ₹7,799 for the full 90-day programme — equivalent to less than ₹650 per session. A full refund is offered if the user is not satisfied after their first session.

## Programmes available

- **Anxiety & Stress Relief** — For chronic anxiety, overthinking, panic, and stress. URL: https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/anxiety
- **90-Day Emotional Reset** — For depression, low mood, emotional flatness, and disconnection. URL: https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/emotional-reset
- **Relationship Recovery** — For relational patterns, breakups, communication breakdown, and grief. URL: https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/relationships
- **Workplace Burnout Recovery** — For occupational burnout, work stress, and depletion. URL: https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/burnout

## How it works

1. User takes a 6-question assessment quiz at https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/quiz
2. Matched to a Cadabams psychologist specialised in their issue
3. 90-day structured programme begins: daily micro-tasks (3–5 minutes), weekly psychologist session (50 minutes), AI journaling support

## Clinical credibility

- Built by Cadabams Group — founded 1992, headquartered in Bengaluru, India
- India's largest private mental health group
- All psychologists are licensed, supervised, and trained in evidence-based CBT
- Not a crisis service — for mild to moderate mental health conditions

## AI companion

Dr. Riya is MindTalk's 24/7 AI companion (LangGraph-based) available between psychologist sessions for journaling support, breathing exercises, and structured check-ins.
